title: Count your Blessings
lyrics_original: When upon life’s billows you are tempest tossed,
When you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.
Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God hath done!
Count your blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.
Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, every doubt will fly,
And you will keep singing as the days go by. || Count ||
When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold;
Count your many blessings. Wealth can never buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high. || Count ||
So, amid the conflict whether great or small,
Do not be disheartened, God is over all;
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey’s end. || Count ||

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము ఆయన చేసిన ఉపకారములలో దేనిని మరువకుము
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రతి విషయమునందును కృతజ్ఞతాస్తుతులు చెల్లించుడి. ఈలాగు చేయుట యేసుక్రీస్తునందు మీ విషయములో దేవుని చిత్తము.
bible_verses.english: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా చేసిన కార్యములను,పూర్వము జరిగిన నీ ఆశ్చర్యకార్యములను నేను మనస్సునకు తెచ్చుకొందును
bible_verses.english: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, when life feels stormy and my burdens weigh heavy on my heart, help me to fix my eyes on You. Teach me to pause and remember Your constant goodness, naming the many ways You have cared for me. Surprise my heart today with a fresh vision of Your faithfulness, and give me a thankful spirit in every season. Thank You for the ultimate blessing of Your love and grace in Jesus. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, when life feels stormy and my burdens weigh heavy on my heart, help me to fix my eyes on You. Teach me to pause and remember Your constant goodness, naming the many ways You have cared for me. Surprise my heart today with a fresh vision of Your faithfulness, and give me a thankful spirit in every season. Thank You for the ultimate blessing of Your love and grace in Jesus. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life’s storms can easily overwhelm us, making our burdens feel too heavy to carry. Yet, this beloved hymn gently reminds us to pause and look for God's presence even in the midst of trial. When we intentionally name His past faithfulness and daily mercies, our perspective shifts from our anxieties to His unfailing love. Counting our blessings isn't about ignoring hardship, but about anchoring our hearts in the truth of what God has already done for us through Christ.
